The corrected suite asserts full rollback for the forged scope and retires the detector before advancing its taxonomy.
retained_attempts.interpretation: These observed failures were invalid test-fixture expectations; no SQL033, repository or versioned-parser change was needed for the passing retry.

limitations: This is exact local dirty-tree qualification based on 4cbde6a9. The 255 explicit source hashes identify tested bytes; later changes or published revisions require their own evidence.

The private content counter covers assets, domains, placements and classification taxonomy/rule/assignment heads. It does not replace identity, membership, policy, approval or environmental freshness checks.
